entities.summary: John Ampontuah Kumah was a Ghanaian politician, businessman, preacher and a lawyer. He served as the chief executive officer of the National Entrepreneurship and Innovation Programme (NEIP) until elected as the Member of parliament for the Ejisu constituency in the 2020 Ghanaian general election on the ticket New Patriotic Party (NPP).
